reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 08, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA, full white/cyan/alpha review sheet and unchanged naiwa.png; checked cap, covered hair, brows, absence of clearly added facial hair and glasses, one neutral mouth, uniform/collar counts, note occlusion, pose, crop, lighting, collar fit, complete card/backplate and visible transparency.

entries.positive_observation: The dark olive peaked cap with small gold front insignia and gold visor leaves, almost entirely covered hair and dark eyebrows beneath the visor remain. The chin is smooth and rounded with no clearly added moustache or beard, one neutral closed mouth and no spectacles. The nearly frontal capped head and shoulders, direct-to-slightly-left gaze, chest-up crop and soft frontal facial light moderated by the cap brim are retained. The dark olive uniform keeps two red collar patches with gold details, gold shoulder trim at viewer left and the dark central collar area; the note still occludes the viewer-right chest. The high collar fits a short broad neck beneath the rounded chin without a long yellow column, pinching, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque muted gray-olive photographic backplate, overlapping warm-cream note with compact upper marks and mostly blank lower paper, and small dark right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan inspection shows a genuine transparent exterior without visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte halo.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept native RGBA extrema 0..254 after actual white/cyan/alpha inspection; no source-alpha replacement was performed or needed, and 252-254 values alone were not treated as defects.
entries.visible_limitations: Exact cap and collar insignia and very fine upper-lip pixels are not reliably readable at 65x67; no clear facial-hair addition is visible and no exact symbols are claimed. Note marks remain indistinct visual groups rather than readable text.
